name: v1.52.0
body:
### Added Features

- passthrough-exact-format copies matching syft-json input unchanged [PR [#5279](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5279) @juanjsebgarcia]

### Bug Fixes

- bound what a compressed kernel module expands to [PR [#5294](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5294) @wagoodman]
- bound the decompressed members of a .deb archive [PR [#5293](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5293) @wagoodman]
- alpm mtree gzip unbounded processing [PR [#5292](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5292) @wagoodman]
- graalvm unbounded allocation [PR [#5291](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5291) @wagoodman]
- harden .NET PE/ELF parsing against malformed binaries [PR [#5267](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5267) @wagoodman]
- bound allocations from UPX-packed binary headers [PR [#5195](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5195) @wagoodman]
- Syft rpm-db-cataloger reports stale libssh version from a single-layer Rocky Linux 10 image [Issue [#5247](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/5247)]
- java-archive-cataloger returns unknown ver for uber-jars [Issue [#5163](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/5163)] [PR [#5164](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5164) @rezmoss]

### Dependencies

52 dependency changes (52 updated). 6 vulnerabilities remediated.

**🟢 Remediated (6)**

- [GHSA-2v4p-qf9q-27wj](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-2v4p-qf9q-27wj) (High) — google.golang.org/grpc
